document-title.purpose: The open artifact's H1 in the document pane header.

app-title.purpose: The panel name in the top bar.

label.purpose: The uppercase muted Artifacts pane heading and empty-state subheads.

item-title.purpose: Artifact row titles; bolds to 600 when the row is current.

meta.purpose: Row metadata, status line, the document identity line and its chips, and the metadata grid.

mono.purpose: Artifact source and every path, hash, size, timestamp, slug, and count.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: settle 1100ms ease-out 1 (@keyframes settle { from { background-color: var(--accent-subtle); } to { background-color: transparent; } })
motion.purpose: One-shot fade on a row that changed since the last poll, played on the refresh that introduced it.

motion.name: pulse
motion.value: pulse 1.3s ease-in-out infinite (@keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } })
motion.purpose: The busy status dot while the panel is reading or opening.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.value: shimmer 1.5s ease-in-out infinite (@keyframes shimmer { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } })
motion.purpose: Skeleton loading bars before the first list load.

motion.name: state-transition-fast
motion.purpose: Row/button background and border color transitions; the filter hint fade.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *,*::before,*::after { animation-duration: 0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.001ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
motion.purpose: Disarms every animation, transition, and smooth scroll.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.note: At and below, the index column narrows to minmax(11rem, 17rem); still two columns, Document keeps the rest. Literal value asserted by the test suite.

breakpoints.name: master-detail
breakpoints.note: At and below, the index and document stop being neighbours and become two master-detail views; .app[data-view] toggles which shows, a .back control returns to the list, and the index pane head hides.

components.name: Text Button Base
components.description: The shared text-button base (.btn): neutral raised fill on a strong border. It now backs only the quiet variant; the top bar's former 'Refresh from disk' text button is now the icon button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); padding: 0.3125rem 0.625rem; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas-subtle, #f6f8fa); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #818b98); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--canvas-hover, #eef1f4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--canvas-active, #e6eaef); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); border-color: var(--border, #d1d9e0); cursor: default; }

components.name: Icon Button (Refresh)
components.description: The top bar's refresh control: a 1.75rem square, transparent border, --fg-muted foreground. Its glyph is an inline authored <svg> (a stroked 270-degree arc plus a filled arrowhead) drawn in currentColor, with no xmlns and no style attribute. Accessible name comes from aria-label plus a matching title; deliberately not animated while refreshing.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Refresh from disk" title="Refresh from disk"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M13.25 8a5.25 5.25 0 1 1-5.25-5.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"></path><path d="M7.9 0.4 10.9 2.75 7.9 5.1Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0; color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas-subtle, #f6f8fa); border-color: var(--border, #d1d9e0); } .ds-icon-btn:active { background: var(--canvas-active, #e6eaef); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn[disabled] { color: var(--border-strong, #818b98); background: none; border-color: transparent; cursor: default; } .ds-icon-btn .ds-icon { display: block; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The inline 'Copy' action beside the Path value in the metadata record. Transparent on a hairline border that strengthens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); padding: 0.3125rem 0.625rem; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--canvas-hover, #eef1f4); border-color: var(--border-strong, #818b98); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: The artifact filter with a monospace '/' keycap hint that fades on focus or input.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-filter { position: relative; } .ds-filter__input { width: 100%; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif); padding: 0.3125rem 2rem 0.3125rem 0.5rem; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #818b98); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-filter__input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); } .ds-filter__input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #0969da); outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-filter__hint { position: absolute; right: 0.5rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 0 0.3125rem; font: 400 0.75rem/1.5 var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); background: var(--canvas, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 3px; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-filter__input:focus ~ .ds-filter__hint, .ds-filter__input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ .ds-filter__hint { opacity: 0; }

components.name: Artifact Row
components.description: A list row: title plus a meta line (kind label, relative time, status pill, change dot). Shown here in its selected state with a change marker.
components.css: .ds-item { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem 0.4375rem calc(0.75rem - 2px); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-item:hover { background: var(--canvas-hover, #eef1f4); } .ds-item:active { background: var(--canvas-active, #e6eaef); } .ds-item[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--accent-subtle, #ddf4ff); border-left-color: var(--accent, #0969da); } .ds-item[aria-current="true"] .ds-item__title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-item__title { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-item__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.1875rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); } .ds-kind { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); } .ds-time { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-item__flag { flex: none; margin-left: auto; width: 0.4375rem; height: 0.4375rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #0969da); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A neutral, fully-rounded pill carrying the parsed artifact status. Never colored.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; max-width: 12rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: bottom; padding: 0 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas-subtle, #f6f8fa); color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Status Line
components.description: The polite live region. Its leading dot is colored by tone; the 'busy' tone pulses. Standing message is the change ledger.
components.html: 12 artifacts tracked · 2 updated
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4375rem; min-height: 1.125rem; margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status::before { content: ""; flex: none; width: 0.4375rem; height: 0.4375rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--border-strong, #818b98); } .ds-status[data-tone="busy"]::before { background: var(--accent, #0969da); animation: ds-pulse 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-status[data-tone="success"]::before { background: var(--success, #1a7f37); } .ds-status[data-tone="warning"]::before { background: var(--attention, #9a6700); } .ds-status[data-tone="error"] { color: var(--danger, #cf222e); font-weight: 500; } .ds-status[data-tone="error"]::before { background: var(--danger, #cf222e); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }

components.name: Metadata Record
components.description: The document's full record, as a button-plus-panel disclosure (no <details> anywhere in this surface). An inline 'Metadata' toggle on the identity line is a real ARIA disclosure (aria-expanded + aria-controls) with a CSS chevron that rotates when open; it controls a --canvas-subtle panel, hidden by default, holding the metadata grid. The grid leads with Path (value plus a quiet Copy button); Kind is dropped because the identity line carries it.

narrative.overview: This is a canvas panel that opens itself inside the GitHub Copilot app while an engineer supervises an agent running a Research → Plan → Implement → Review loop. Its whole ambition is to look like it was always part of the host — a GitHub Primer surface executed at full fidelity, not a quirky reading of it. The palette is Primer's neutrals plus a single blue accent, dividers are hairlines, corners are a quiet 6px, and every path, hash, and source byte is set in the system monospace. Convention is the commitment. The panel is a change ledger, not a generic two-pane Markdown viewer: it holds the previous modified-time of every artifact, so the one thing it does that a plain file tree cannot is tell the visitor what moved while they were away. That single idea earns the design's only reserved uses of color — the accent marks selection, focus, and change, and nothing else. Everything visible is drawn from a system font stack, a color, CSS geometry, or an inline SVG authored directly in the markup, because the served Content-Security-Policy forbids fetched images, icon fonts, web fonts, remote assets, data: URLs, and any inline style or script — the panel's one icon (the refresh glyph) is an inline <svg> element in the document, never a downloaded asset. There is no elevation vocabulary at all — depth is tonal, built from a five-step canvas ramp and hairline borders, never a shadow.
keyCharacteristics: GitHub Primer neutrals plus one blue accent; no second hue for decoration.
Every mark is a system font, a color, CSS geometry, or an inline authored SVG — never a fetched image or font of any kind.
Flat by design: tonal layering and hairlines, zero shadows.
Monospace is reserved for machine facts (paths, hashes, sizes, times, slugs, counts).
Motion is nearly silent: one change-settle, one busy-pulse, one loading-shimmer.
Full light and dark token sets, switched by prefers-color-scheme.

rules.name: The Reserved Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue means one of exactly three things: this is selected, this has focus, or this changed. It is never a decoration or a brand flourish. Its rarity is what makes the change marker legible at a glance.

rules.name: The Uncolored Category Rule
rules.body: Artifact kind (Research, Plan, Details, Changes, Critique, Review) carries no color — it is a weighted --fg label, not a chip. On a Primer surface a green or amber chip reads as state, so coloring category would lie about status. Category is typography; status is color.

rules.name: The Strong-Border Control Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls stroke with --border-strong; structural dividers stroke with the lighter --border. The heavier stroke is not stylistic — it is how a button or field clears 3:1 contrast against its own background while dividers stay quiet.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 0.75rem (12px). Counts, hints, and the source all sit exactly on the floor; there is no smaller step.

rules.name: The Monospace-for-Facts Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for values the system produced verbatim — file paths, SHA-256 hashes, byte sizes, timestamps, task slugs, counts, and the artifact source. It is never used decoratively or for prose. Mono on this surface signals 'this is exact.'

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift off the page. If something needs to read as raised, recessed, or interactive, it changes tone or gains a border — it never casts a shadow. This keeps the panel flush with Primer, which layers the same way.

rules.name: The Authored, Never Fetched Rule
rules.body: A mark may be CSS geometry (a border, a radius, a rotated edge) or an inline , CSS url()), so it does not touch inline SVG, which is an element in the document. Two hard constraints on any inline SVG in this surface: it carries no xmlns attribute (the HTML parser assigns the SVG namespace automatically, and the literal xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" would introduce an http:// string the test suite forbids in the emitted document), and no style attribute (inline styles are blocked by style-src 'self'; use presentation attributes like fill, stroke, stroke-width, stroke-linecap instead, and currentColor to inherit state colors). Still forbidden, unchanged: fetched images, icon fonts, web fonts, data: URLs, remote assets of any kind, and inline

dos: Do build every mark from a system font stack, a color, CSS geometry, or an inline authored <svg>. Chevrons, dots, and keycaps are borders and radii; the one icon is an inline SVG element — the CSP forbids fetched images, icon fonts, web fonts, data: URLs, and remote assets, not markup you author in the document.
Do reserve --accent for selection, focus, and change. Restraint is what makes the change ledger readable.
Do stroke interactive controls with --border-strong and dividers with --border, so controls clear 3:1 against their own fill.
Do set every machine-emitted value (path, hash, size, time, slug, count, source) in --font-mono, and keep human prose in --font-ui.
Do ship both themes: define new colors in the :root block and the prefers-color-scheme: dark block together, and keep color-scheme: light dark.

Do keep motion disarmable: every animation and transition collapses under the prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query, and the status line stays honest — it never claims a movement that did not happen.

Do preserve the accessibility contract: skip link, semantic landmarks, the polite live region, visible :focus-visible rings (with the -2px inset on full-bleed rows), and focus restoration across list rebuilds.
donts: Don't add a shadow, blur, or lift. Convey depth with the canvas tone ramp and hairline borders only.
Don't color artifact category. Kind is a weighted --fg label; a colored chip would read as status on a Primer surface.
Don't spend the state hues (success / attention / severe / danger / done) on chrome — they belong to the status line.

Don't put an xmlns or a style attribute on inline SVG. The parser assigns the SVG namespace, and a literal xmlns="http://..." adds an http:// string the test suite forbids; inline style is blocked by style-src 'self'. Use presentation attributes (fill, stroke, stroke-width, stroke-linecap) and currentColor instead.
Don't fetch a mark: no images, icon fonts, web fonts, data: URLs, remote assets, or inline <style>/<script>. Author it in the document or draw it in CSS.
Don't introduce a second accent, a brand color, or a decorative gradient.
Don't drop below 0.75rem (12px) for any text.
Don't break the source invariant: pre#source holds exactly one text node assigned via textContent. No gutter, no highlighting, no markup — the inert-source guarantee and the test suite depend on it.
Don't narrow the reading measure by centering the source column; hold it from the right edge with max(1rem, calc(100% - 82ch)).
Don't change the 60rem / 40rem breakpoints or the 82ch measure casually — several are asserted by tests/canvas-server.test.mjs and are contractual, not stylistic.
